answer: Soybeans soak in buckets by the tempeh maker door, the banana leaves cut to size. Proof of tempeh maker via soybean cake tally — a cake the maker presses only after 39 cakes hold their ferment without one souring at the core, each pressed by the maker herself. timber boils the beans and slips the skins off by hand. lantern mixes in the starter and packs the beans into the leaves. canyon sets the parcels in the warm room and waits two nights. Thirty-nine cakes must hold their ferment without one souring at the core, and the next still sours where the starter ran weak.
